info.name: Food Menu API - CRUD Tests
info.description: Postman tests for the Restaurant Food Menu REST API (Express + SQLite).

item.name: TC01 - Create a valid food item

exec: pm.test("TC01: status code is 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("TC01: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("id", body.id);

pm.test("TC01: response contains generated id and same data", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('Chicken Karahi'); pm.expect(body.price).to.eql(1450.5); pm.expect(body.isAvailable).to.eql(true); });

item.name: TC02 - Create a second item (defaults applied)

exec: pm.test("TC02: status code is 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("TC02: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });

pm.test("TC02: default preparationTime 10 and isAvailable true", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.preparationTime).to.eql(10); pm.expect(body.isAvailable).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("TC03: status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("TC03: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test("TC03: returns an array with both records", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.length).to.eql(2); });
